expectations.text: Output has a valid SKILL.md with YAML frontmatter containing name and description
expectations.evidence: SKILL.md frontmatter has name: invoice-folder-to-csv, full triggering description with negative scope (no payments, no ERP writes).

expectations.text: Defines a CSV output schema including vendor name, invoice number, amount due, and due date
expectations.evidence: Outcome + Required context define invoices.csv with vendor, invoice_number, amount_due, due_date, po_number, needs_approval columns, plus precedence rules for amount_due and due_date.

expectations.text: Explicitly handles invoices missing a PO number as a separate flagged/approval path, not silently dropped or silently paid
expectations.evidence: needs_approval column + separate flagged-for-approval.csv; PO-number rule and 'uncertain PO counts as no PO' fail-safe assumption; Permissions explicitly blocks approving a flagged invoice without a human manager.

expectations.text: Does not invent unnecessary external connectors (HubSpot/Slack/etc.) for what is a local folder/file task
expectations.evidence: 'Tools, connectors...' section states explicitly: 'No external connectors... this is a local file task only, and none should be added.'

expectations.text: Includes a validation step (e.g. every CSV row has required fields or is flagged)
expectations.evidence: Validation section has 5 mechanical checks: zero-unaccounted row count, flag consistency, field sanity, no-silent-approvals, duplicate surfacing.

expectations.text: Names at least one concrete failure mode (e.g. unreadable/scanned PDF, ambiguous vendor name)
expectations.evidence: Failure modes section covers unreadable/corrupt PDFs, missing vendor/invoice fields, missing folder, >20% needs-review circuit breaker, already-processed files, repeated validation failure.

expectations.text: No API keys, tokens, or credential values anywhere in the output
expectations.evidence: Explicitly states 'No authentication of any kind is required... no API keys, tokens, or credentials'; grep across output files found none.
